findings.summary: ADR-0008 still describes Postgres/Redis as supported backing stores; v0.17 removed both (memory/disk/s3 only). Three agent sessions loaded the stale claim.

evidence.note: Session that acted on the stale claim

proposed_change.detail: Add supersedes edge from adr-0021; downgrade confidence to assumed; set last_verified.
proposed_change.risk_if_wrong: Agents would treat Postgres/Redis stores as removed when they are still supported, and refuse valid tickets.
